entities.title: Daemon error lines
entities.summary: The daemon writes one line per problem it survives to its standard error, prefixed `daemon: `.
entities.name: daemon: ...
entities.meaning: A connection that failed (a peer of another uid, a malformed or oversize request, too many descriptors, a missing working directory), an accept error other than would-block, a failed cache write, or a cache that could not be opened (`cache disabled`).
entities.access: Whoever holds the daemon's standard error. A daemon the invoker or the MCP front end starts has it on /dev/null, and the LaunchAgent plist names no log file, so these lines are seen only when `zazzle daemon serve` runs in a terminal.
excludes: Requests, file paths read and command output are not logged.

entities.title: Orchestration records
entities.summary: One text-free JSON line per adaptive investigation, per `zazzle flow` command that called an agent, and per `--llm` post-processing or brief ranking, with the orchestrator's usage apart from the execution agents'.
entities.name: orchestration.jsonl
entities.meaning: Shows which questions needed a planner, how often parts escalate and from which rung, what the orchestrator costs against the executors, and where time goes (queue or run), so the ladder, orchestrator and difficulty rating can be tuned.
entities.unit: one record per run or call (kind: adaptive, flow, post, brief rank)
dimensions: kind: adaptive, flow (command, orchestrator, usage, calls), post or brief rank (agent, orchestrator, hosted, sent_tokens, reported input, cached and output tokens, cost_usd, seconds, ok)
question_hash (12-hex BLAKE3 prefix), question_words, scope_paths, symbols
difficulty and reasons; ladder, orchestrator and planner labels
plan: skipped, planned or fallback; combine: single, combined or merged
parts: start rung and per attempt agent, effort, status, understanding, confidence, findings, rejected, gaps, turns, needs_user and escalated_because (its kind only)
result: the final structured result's status, levels and counts
calls: phase, role, orchestrator flag, agent, hosted, tokens sent by section, input, cached and output tokens, rounds, cost_usd, queued and run seconds, ok
usage: totals with hosted, local, orchestrator and executors apart
entities.access: The user who owns ~/.zazzle; the folder is mode 0700 and a new log is mode 0600.
entities.retention: At 20 MiB the log is renamed to orchestration.jsonl.1, replacing the prior rotated file.
entities.cadence: Per adaptive run, flow command and orchestrator call.
excludes: The question, paths, symbols, claims, citations, gap text and agent replies are never written.
entities.details: ZAZZLE_ORCHESTRATION_LOG moves the file; an empty value disables it. Write failures do not fail the command. The review and the benchmark are separate runs and are not in the record.

entities.title: Final response delivery log
entities.summary: One privacy-preserving JSON line per zazzle command response after budgeting and session dedupe, correlated by the caller's stable session.
entities.name: usage.jsonl
entities.meaning: Measures what daemon produced and what it finally returned, so token savings from session dedupe and command mix can be compared with the C# indexer's source-to-view metrics.
dimensions: pre_dedupe_est_tokens and delivered_est_tokens (about 3.5 UTF-8 bytes per token)
response_hash: 12-hex BLAKE3 prefix of the delivered response
deduplicated: whether the session layer replaced repeated content
entities.access: The user who owns ~/.zazzle; the directory is mode 0700 and a new log is mode 0600.
entities.retention: At 20 MiB the log is renamed to usage.jsonl.1, replacing the prior rotated file.
excludes: Arguments, paths, source text and response text are never written.
entities.details: ZAZZLE_USAGE_LOG moves the file; an empty value disables it. Write failures do not fail the command.
